page_title: ANG 1-1 HAV | Angers v Le Havre 02/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's the end of the match.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
90' 1 - 1 Goal! Ibrahima Niane plays a pass to the feet of Florent Hanin (Angers), and he shoots inside the left post from inside the box. It's 1:1.

89' That didn't go as planned! Zinedine Ferhat (Angers) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort towards the middle of the goal was too weak to get past Mathieu Gorgelin, who easily kept it out.
88' Zinedine Ferhat (Angers) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Mathieu Gorgelin, who smothers the ball.
84' Didier Digard has decided to make a change. Yoann Salmier (Le Havre) replaces Yassine Kechta.
80' Gautier Lloris (Le Havre) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
80' Jeremie Pignard blows his whistle. Gautier Lloris (Le Havre) commits a foul after dangerous play.
79' That will be all from Jean-Eudes Aholou who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Justin-Noel Kalumba (Angers).
78' Zinedine Ferhat (Angers) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending the ball towards the bottom left corner only for Mathieu Gorgelin to dive and make a save.
76' The free kick will be taken by Zinedine Ferhat (Angers).
76' Today's referee Jeremie Pignard rightly decides to book Yassine Kechta (Le Havre) for his harsh tackle.
76' Yassine Kechta (Le Havre) trips an opposition player and Jeremie Pignard signals a foul.
74' Here is a change. Esteban Lepaul is going off and Alexandre Dujeux gives the last tactical orders to Ibrahima Niane (Angers).
74' It is time for a substitution. Zinedine Ferhat (Angers) is on for Farid El Melali.
73' 0 - 1 Goal! Josue Casimir tees up Andre Ayew (Le Havre) inside the box, and he keeps his cool to find the bottom left corner. 0:1.
70' It will be a substitution. Andre Ayew (Le Havre) is ready to enter the pitch as Ahmed Hassan walks off.
70' Didier Digard prepares a substitution. Mahamadou Diawara is replaced by Rassoul Ndiaye (Le Havre).
65' Jeremie Pignard couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Yassine Kechta (Le Havre) and blew his whistle. Angers have a free kick.
62' Ahmed Hassan (Le Havre) rises highest from the corner to head at goal, but his effort towards the underside of the crossbar is brilliantly kept out by the goalkeeper.
61' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Le Havre.

60' Farid El Melali (Angers) does well to evade a couple of challenges then let's fly from distance towards goal, but the effort flies just wide of the right post. That would have been a great goal! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Le Havre.
60' The ball goes out of play and Angers have been awarded a corner kick.

60' Esteban Lepaul (Angers) collects a brilliant pass inside the box and finds himself in a goal scoring opportunity. He takes a shot, but the effort is well blocked by one of the defending players. Angers force a corner. They send men into the box.
58' Yassine Kechta (Le Havre) was too forceful with his tackle and Jeremie Pignard interrupted the game to signal a free kick. Angers have a free kick.
57' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Angers.
51' Abdoulaye Bamba (Angers) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
51' Jeremie Pignard blows the whistle, Abdoulaye Bamba (Angers) is penalised for a foul. A free kick is awarded to Le Havre.

50' That was close by Florent Hanin (Angers)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes inches wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Le Havre.
49' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Angers.
46' Half-time substitution. Jim Allevinah (Angers) is replaced by Abdoulaye Bamba.
46' Didier Digard makes a switch. Issa Soumare is coming on in place of Antoine Joujou (Le Havre) at the start of the second period.
46' The whistle blows and Jeremie Pignard starts the second half.
45+7' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+7' Gautier Lloris (Le Havre) gets to the ball from the resulting corner but blazes it well over the bar.
45+7' Yassine Kechta (Le Havre) prepares to take a corner kick.

45+2' Farid El Melali (Angers) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Jeremie Pignard with no other option than to blow for a foul.
45' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
42' A brilliant individual effort! Farid El Melali (Angers) tricks his way past challenges into the box and drags his shot narrowly wide of the right post.
40' Antoine Joujou (Le Havre) sends a cross into the box, but Yahia Fofana comes off his line to gather the ball.
38' Jordan Lefort whips the ball in and it arrives at the feet of Jean-Eudes Aholou (Angers), whose wild shot goes way over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Le Havre will have a goal kick.
37' The ball goes behind for a corner. Angers will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
35' Ahmed Hassan (Le Havre) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls the ball and drills it to the middle of the goal, but Yahia Fofana makes a comfortable save to stop his effort.
33' Ahmed Hassan (Le Havre) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.

32' Florent Hanin (Angers) lets fly with a crisp shot from inside the box after picking up a lofted pass from Himad Abdelli, but the ball goes a whisker wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Le Havre.
28' Fode Ballo-Toure (Le Havre) is being substituted because of an injury. Didier Digard sends Yanis Zouaoui on the pitch.
25' The referee demonstrates he won't tolerate this behaviour. Himad Abdelli (Angers) is given a yellow card.
25' Josue Casimir (Le Havre) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
18' The ref’s original red card decision for Arouna Sangante (Le Havre) is upheld after a VAR review!

17' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Arouna Sangante (Le Havre), but referee Jeremie Pignard must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
16' Arouna Sangante (Le Havre) is sent off after deserving nothing other than a red card from a referee for clattering into his opponent!
14' Esteban Lepaul (Angers) is being forced to leave the pitch in order to receive medical treatment and his team will play with a man short for a few minutes.
14' Arouna Sangante (Le Havre) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Jeremie Pignard saw the whole situation. Angers will take a free kick.
10' After VAR review the ref signals the yellow card is cancelled but now issues a red. Lilian Rao-Lisoa (Angers) has to leave the pitch!
9' Wait! The referee makes the VAR signal and he's going to review that incident from earlier. This could be a red card for Lilian Rao-Lisoa (Angers)! Let's see what he decides.
8' Lilian Rao-Lisoa (Angers) takes out his opponent with a horrific tackle and is relieved when the referee only shows him a yellow card.
7' Antoine Joujou (Le Havre) is asking for medical treatment, but he will have to leave the pitch in order to receive help from the physio.
7' Lilian Rao-Lisoa (Angers) commits a foul after bringing down his opponent with a slide tackle. Le Havre earn a free kick.
4' Fode Ballo-Toure (Le Havre) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Jeremie Pignard blows for a foul. It's a free kick to Angers in a dangerous position.

3' Lilian Rao-Lisoa (Angers) takes a snap shot from the edge of the box after a rebound, but his effort is a waste as it goes high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Le Havre will have a goal kick.
3' Jean-Eudes Aholou (Angers) receives the ball from the set piece on the edge of the box, but fails to score because his shot is blocked.
2' Loic Nego (Le Havre) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
1' Loic Nego (Le Havre) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Jeremie Pignard blows for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Angers.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Le Havre will have the kick-off.
Jeremie Pignard got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
Show lineups The starting lineups for this match have been revealed.
